Hi Alex / Sophie —

Thanks again for the chat earlier today — really helpful to understand where Acme AI is trying to reduce classification latency and lower per-token costs on production workloads. As discussed, next step is a 45-minute technical demo + deep dive so our infra engineer can walk through the runtime behavior and batching/quantization options.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue 18 Aug — 10:00–10:45am
- Tue 18 Aug — 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed 19 Aug — 9:30–10:15am

I've attached a short agenda (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf) so you know what we'll cover. Can you confirm the best slot? If none of the above work, send 2–3 times that do and we'll prioritize.

Also copying Aditya (infra/serving) who will lead the technical portion — if there are specific benchmarks or logs you'd like us to review first, let us know.

Best,
